reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.

reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.

reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible new or substantially expanded manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; expansion requires prescribed investment/capacity increase. Category and eligible asset tests apply.

reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. Standard investment periods 3/4/5/7 years; minimum 70% state-resident permanent employment. Qualifying expansion must add the relevant threshold investment/jobs.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Policy notified 15 July 2025; precise clauses, negative list, category and eligible costs govern. Annual budget ceiling ₹1000 crore and first-come rules; no live intake/budget inferred. Stamp applies land, excludes building/acquisition of established units. Hill bonus A caps₹5/10/20/40 crore and B₹2/5/10/20 crore; new units only. Financial incentives not automatically cumulative with customized packages.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Excess project cost self-funded and excluded from subsidy. Margin money adjusts after 2 financial years subject to inspection and loan status; geography uses MSME 2023 A–D definitions.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible new or substantially expanded manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; expansion requires prescribed investment/capacity increase. Category and eligible asset tests apply.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. No same-component double assistance. Qualifying expansion receives capital assistance only; other components are for new units. Land/working capital excluded. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible new or substantially expanded manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; expansion requires prescribed investment/capacity increase. Category and eligible asset tests apply.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Excess project cost self-funded and excluded from subsidy. Margin money adjusts after 2 financial years subject to inspection and loan status; geography uses MSME 2023 A–D definitions.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible new or substantially expanded manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; expansion requires prescribed investment/capacity increase. Category and eligible asset tests apply.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. No same-component double assistance. Qualifying expansion receives capital assistance only; other components are for new units. Land/working capital excluded. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. Standard investment periods 3/4/5/7 years; minimum 70% state-resident permanent employment. Qualifying expansion must add the relevant threshold investment/jobs.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Policy notified 15 July 2025; precise clauses, negative list, category and eligible costs govern. Hill bonus A caps₹5/10/20/40 crore and B₹2/5/10/20 crore; new units only. Financial incentives not automatically cumulative with customized packages.

reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Excess project cost self-funded and excluded from subsidy. Margin money adjusts after 2 financial years subject to inspection and loan status; geography uses MSME 2023 A–D definitions.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible new or substantially expanded manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; expansion requires prescribed investment/capacity increase. Category and eligible asset tests apply.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. No same-component double assistance. Qualifying expansion receives capital assistance only; other components are for new units. Land/working capital excluded. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: New Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs in permitted activities; in-principle CAF approval before commercial production, required operating approvals and minimum 70% permanent employment to state permanent residents. Public/PPP enterprises excluded. Term loan for eligible workshop and plant/equipment from approved lender; land, working capital and already subsidised-interest borrowing excluded.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: New Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs in permitted activities; in-principle CAF approval before commercial production, required operating approvals and minimum 70% permanent employment to state permanent residents. Public/PPP enterprises excluded.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: New Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs in permitted activities; in-principle CAF approval before commercial production, required operating approvals and minimum 70% permanent employment to state permanent residents. reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Certification-related plant cost eligible only if capital subsidy was not taken for it; travel/hotel and unrelated expenses excluded.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.

reviews.applicantProfile: New Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs in permitted activities; in-principle CAF approval before commercial production, required operating approvals and minimum 70% permanent employment to state permanent residents. reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Separate state award; national ZED programme benefits remain common records.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. Standard investment periods 3/4/5/7 years; minimum 70% state-resident permanent employment. Qualifying expansion must add the relevant threshold investment/jobs.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Policy notified 15 July 2025; precise clauses, negative list, category and eligible costs govern. Annual budget ceiling ₹1000 crore and first-come rules; no live intake/budget inferred. Stamp applies land, excludes building/acquisition of established units. Hill bonus A caps₹5/10/20/40 crore and B₹2/5/10/20 crore; new units only. Financial incentives not automatically cumulative with customized packages.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible new or substantially expanded manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; expansion requires prescribed investment/capacity increase. Category and eligible asset tests apply.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.

reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. reviews.applicantProfile: New threshold projects in healthcare, hospitality, AYUSH/wellness, K 12/college, film/entertainment, sports, IT/GCC, data centres and specified skilling Co Es. E. g. IT/GCC >₹100 crore plains/>₹50 crore hills plus 1000/500 direct jobs; sports >₹25/15 crore. See sector table.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Existing construction/grounded projects at notification excluded. Annual approvals first-come with waitlist. Overlap requires policy choice; hospitality cannot combine this capital subsidy with Tourism 2023 capital subsidy.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Project complying with Film Policy 2024; affidavit 75% or more shot in state, verified geotagged shooting-days evidence,4 K/Dolby Digital record, artist/technician payment NOCs and required credits.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Precise subsidy entitlement remains indicative pending policy schedule. At least 90% production expenses paid by bank/digital channels; Council may reject subject to quality, compliance and budget. Current intake/budget unconfirmed.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Permanent/native Uttarakhand resident age 18+, non-defaulter; commercially viable permitted enterprise excluding traditional agriculture/prohibited activities. One beneficiary per defined family, once; no other self-employment scheme benefit in preceding 5 financial years.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Excess project cost self-funded and excluded from subsidy. Margin money adjusts after 2 financial years subject to inspection and loan status; geography uses MSME 2023 A–D definitions.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible new or substantially expanded manufacturing MSMEs and permitted non-conventional energy units; expansion requires prescribed investment/capacity increase. Category and eligible asset tests apply.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. No same-component double assistance. Qualifying expansion receives capital assistance only; other components are for new units. Land/working capital excluded. PMEGP/PMFME/MSY margin assistance for corresponding term-loan assets deducted; only balance top-up payable. First claim within 1 year of production; micro 2 annual instalments, small/medium 5.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.

reviews.applicantProfile: New Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs in permitted activities; in-principle CAF approval before commercial production, required operating approvals and minimum 70% permanent employment to state permanent residents. reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.

reviews.applicantProfile: New Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs in permitted activities; in-principle CAF approval before commercial production, required operating approvals and minimum 70% permanent employment to state permanent residents. Public/PPP enterprises excluded.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.

reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. reviews.applicantProfile: New Uttarakhand manufacturing MSMEs in permitted activities; in-principle CAF approval before commercial production, required operating approvals and minimum 70% permanent employment to state permanent residents. Public/PPP enterprises excluded. Obtain specified Ministry of MSME ZED certificate.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Existence verified; current intake and available budget not established as of 2 October 2026. Confirm with implementing office before investment. Separate state award; national ZED programme benefits remain common records.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.

reviews.applicantProfile: Eligible large manufacturing units with plant investment >₹50 crore; investment categories on eligible workshop+plant: >₹50–200 crore with ≥50 permanent jobs; >₹200–500 crore with ≥150 jobs; >₹500–1000 crore with ≥300 jobs; >₹1000 crore with ≥500 jobs. Standard investment periods 3/4/5/7 years; minimum 70% state-resident permanent employment. Qualifying expansion must add the relevant threshold investment/jobs.
reviews.whyMapped: Activity and value-chain stage match the published programme surface; applicant and component eligibility remain mandatory.
reviews.condition: Policy notified 15 July 2025; precise clauses, negative list, category and eligible costs govern. Annual budget ceiling ₹1000 crore and first-come rules; no live intake/budget inferred. Stamp applies land, excludes building/acquisition of established units. Hill bonus A caps₹5/10/20/40 crore and B₹2/5/10/20 crore; new units only. Financial incentives not automatically cumulative with customized packages.
reviews.applicationSequence: Check eligibility and live intake; obtain approval before incurring scheme-linked expenditure.
reviews.convergence: Disclose other assistance; apply the programme top-up and no-double-funding rules.
